quest.title: The Second Experiment: The World
quest.description: After the experiment begins, Albedo first checks your elemental flow. The result is that both your internal and external elemental flows run smoothly and that there is nothing unusual about them. These results seem very normal indeed, but according to Albedo, this is something to be happy about.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Observe the installations in the camp

dialogues.speaker: Observe Shelf
dialogues.text: (A shelf packed with books and potions. Looks like the owner has a habit of reading and researching potions simultaneously.)

talks.objective: Observe the installations in the camp

dialogues.speaker: Observe Table
dialogues.text: (Looks like an alchemy work table. Some potions and other apparatus are laid out here. Are these what Albedo uses to investigate the world?)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Table
dialogues.text: (It wouldn't hurt to touch it... would it?)

talks.objective: Observe the installations in the camp

dialogues.speaker: Observe Record Board
dialogues.text: (A board with some incomprehensible experimental reports stuck onto it.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe Record Board
dialogues.text: (Still, you can tell that progress is being made on those experiments.)

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm back. Did you see anything interesting?

choices.text: Couldn't make heads or tails of anything.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not to worry, they're all for alchemical purposes, you'd be hard pressed to find an everyday use for them.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, on with the research.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: There may be significant differences between different worlds.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Take Teyvat, for example. Here, those with Visions can manipulate the elements.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But worlds may well exist where only one person is able to do so, or even everyone.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: #So, leaving elements to one side... Do you possess any... unique abilities, {NICKNAME}? Ones that don't exist in this world?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I think answering this question calls for the same methodology as last time. In other words, time for the next experiment.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: No, no! You shan't be required to exert quite so much effort this time around.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Now, see this pillar here. Use your willpower to try and break it.

choices.text: Sorry, I just can't do it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: That was your best effort? Hmm... Well, can't be helped, I suppose.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with the disappointment!? Isn't that, like, impossible?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Ah! Have you tried using your elemental power with food? I don't mean for cooking as such — rather, channeling your power into the ingredients themselves.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I'm curious to see how the taste and texture respond. It may even help with... proliferation...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Haha, I suppose I have a curiosity for things that others find surprising.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Anyway, why don't you cook us up a Sunshine Sprat? I've just finished preparing the recipe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cooking? Paimon was looking forward to more mad scientist stuff!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not only is this recipe a staple for me, it's also worth experimenting with and highly nutritious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, Paimon bets you're just hungry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It does sound yummy though... Okay, Paimon approves!

choices.text: I know what you're getting at.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmm, good buddies are always on the same page!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I'll leave you to it, then. Looking forward to the results.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If there's anything left over, maybe Timaeus can finish the last morsels.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... Paimon doesn't think we'll have that problem.

choices.text: I'll save you a fin or two.
Paimon, you give it a shot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You think Paimon knows how to do that stuff?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: That was your best effort? Hmm... Well, can't be helped, I suppose.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm, agreed. I'd love to find a moment to put them all in order. Still, experiments come first...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Mm! An average outcome experimentally, but you've really brought out the flavor. You seem well-versed in the science of gastronomy.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As far as the proliferation hypothesis is concerned, we've come up short. Seems like food presents the same headaches in your world as it does ours.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Unless... Could it be that the natural laws of this world are limiting your unique abilities?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just didn't know how to channel elemental power into the food. It's a little more complicated than adding herbs and spices, y'know!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Not to worry, at least we put some food to good use, no need to feel disheartened.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And here's your portion, enjoy! I can box it up if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo, thanks! Glad you were paying attention.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I can tell that you're good friends. Paimon was keeping an eye on you and your safety during the whole experiment.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not that Paimon would have been able to do much if things had gone wrong, but anyway...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You were being nice a second ago!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you do have tasty recipes, so Paimon forgives you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you're right, we are good friends. You have good friends too, right? Good students?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: ...Uh, yes! I'm fortunate too, I suppose. Anyway, moving on to the next experiment.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: There are all manner of alchemical items here, keeping them in their proper place is a challenge at the best of times. A while ago, I had the misfortune of misplacing a batch.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I managed to retrieve the majority, but two vials have been evading me: Anemo Crystalfly elemental extract and Electro Hypostasis powder.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's barely finished eating and you want us to go gathering again?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Don't worry if you can't locate them. I was planning to replace them anyway, though finding them would save me the hassle.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If you had, say, a "superpower," like night vision, or vibratory sensing, lost property would be a thing of the past.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I must have dropped them somewhere in the area where you were looking just now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... guess we'd better take a look?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There should be some elemental traces on the lost items.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah! You could use Elemental Sight!

choices.text: Not often that Paimon gets this much attention.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm, an average outcome for a fine dish.

talks.objective: Cook some Sunshine Sprat and give it to Albedo
Use Elemental Sight to look for the lost items

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm, an interesting term... Compelling.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: See what you can find, I'll be over here.

talks.objective: Talk to Albedo and hear his conclusions

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Goodness, you managed to find them? Incredible, a thousand thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I'm wondering, this Elemental Sight... This is what allowed you to locate the items, and find me here in the mountains, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Guess it does sorta count as a superpower, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, though Elemental Sight is seldom seen, it is not unheard of in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Only a never-before-seen, otherworldly power would be of benefit to my research.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... We failed again...?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't be disheartened, this falls entirely within my expectations. Besides, getting these items back? I'd call this a very worthwhile experiment.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I have to commend your deduction that the items would contain elemental traces.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Right then. Up until now, our research has focused on your otherworldly identity. Our research on your identity as one of us is just beginning.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In essence, the differences between humans are reflected in our intellectual and physical capabilities. Let's start with physical.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Looking out from where we're standing, can you see what Sucrose is doing?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: And if you jumped from here and landed on that cliff — the one over there — could you see her then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: So what about if you planted a single blow on the mountain face here and it burst into a million fragments? Then could you see her?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm, then I shouldn't get too excited. Still, we'll gain a more thorough understanding with an experiment.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I know of a location that will be perfect for a physical test. Please, follow me.

choices.text: Sounds like we're still on the superpower test.
...How do I get off this train?
